name: Wooden corbel balcony
parts: three carved timber corbels with scroll tips and groove lines
five floor joists with chamfered ends
four chamfered posts with pyramid caps
pointed slat balustrade on three sides with top and bottom rails
style: Alpine chalet timber balcony, silver-brown weathered spruce, checks and splits, dark stained corbels, rust bleed at bolts, moss in the corbel joints
summary: Alpine timber balcony, 2.0 m: carved corbels, joists, scalloped fascia, plank floor, pointed slat balustrade.
